entities.name: Mirrodin's Core
entities.description: A massive globular space within Mirrodin, used by Memnarch to control the outer world; later the Mycosynth Gardens of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane whose core Memnarch used.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Creator of the Ascension Web who wanted to become a planeswalker like his creator, Karn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Creator of Memnarch, who unintentionally brought glistening oil to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mana Core
entities.description: A ball of pure mana at the center of Mirrodin's Core.

entities.name: Ascension Web
entities.description: A device used to transfer a planeswalker's spark, powered by the destruction of souls.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: Event caused when Memnarch triggered the Ascension Web and was destroyed.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: What Mirrodin became under Phyrexian takeover; its core became the eighth sphere.

entities.name: Mycosynth Gardens
entities.description: The eighth sphere of New Phyrexia, formerly Mirrodin's Core.

entities.name: Norn
entities.description: A Praetor who forbids visitors to the Mycosynth Gardens without invitation.

events.summary: Memnarch triggers the Ascension Web using soul traps but is destroyed, causing the Vanishing.
events.quote: He managed to trigger the Ascension Web using the soul traps , but was destroyed and instead caused the Vanishing to occur.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian takeover, the Phyrexians drill holes into the core, which becomes a sphere of New Phyrexia.
events.quote: the Phyrexians drilled holes into the core and it became one of the three spheres of New Phyrexia
